newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex shareholders back Vedior listing.
newsitem.headline: Vendex shareholders back Vedior listing.

text.p: Dutch retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Wednesday that shareholders had approved the previously announced separate float of its Vedior unit in London and Amsterdam.
"The shareholders of Vendex International...have approved ...the planned spin off and bourse launch of the Vedior group," Vendex said in a statement.
Two days ago, Vendex confirmed its plans to list the unit separately in London and Amsterdam in June, placing between 600 and 650 million guilders worth of ordinary shares in Vedior.
Marketing and bookbuilding is expected to to take place in the second half of May, with Morgan Stanley & Co International acting as global co-ordinator.
